title: Sync upstream RapidRAW 07f1b60d: highlight reconstruction, non-destructive AI denoise and negatives, faster previews
source: CyberTimon/RapidRAW main at 07f1b60da5dcf68525afd00c858fed31c641d4a9 (normal merge; RapidRoom conflict resolution with Claude)
notes: Adopts upstream colour-preserving highlight reconstruction with clip-level detection for Bayer raws, the highlights-slider jump fix, shader feature gates and GPU/mask/LUT caches, non-destructive AI denoise and negative conversion, Auto Adjust strength levels without brightness changes, auto straighten, unlocked mapping on filesystems without flock, the WebKitGTK LUT swatch fix and a Lensfun update. Preserves RapidRoom sidecars (no default-sidecar deletion), atomic writes and card mode, the validated AI denoise tiling and colour restoration, the denoise queue, multi-exposure white balance before calibration, image-bound depth and normal maps, DPI export, stacks and the library header. Rendering changes are subject to full60 evidence and maintainer approval; no references are changed.
